subject: Post-demo: scheduling peak QPS stress test & MAP milestone
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Gonzalez <alex.gonzalez@helixhealth.com>, Priya Banerjee <p.banerjee@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-demo: scheduling peak QPS stress test & MAP milestone

Thanks again for the demo earlier — the team was excited by the latency numbers and the routing fallbacks. As discussed, next MAP milestone is the stress/peak-QPS run to validate dedicated sizing and final SLA targets. I captured the proposed items below so we can lock dates. Please confirm the bold items and upload the traffic profile when convenient.

Summary / asks: 
- Objective: validate 1-hour sustained peak plus 5-min spikes to mirror Black Friday-like profile; confirm dedicated sizing recommendation.
- Redwood deliverables: runbook (attached), dedicated capacity sizing worksheet, on-call engineer for the run window.
- Helix deliverables: traffic profile (CSV) with 1-min granularity, list of session types (mobile/web/api), expected peak QPS per type, test tenant credentials.
- Candidate windows (pick one):
  1) 2026-11-29 02:00–04:00 UTC (evening PST)
  2) 2026-12-02 08:00–10:00 UTC (morning PST)
- Target close impact: sizing sign-off and purchase addendum by 2026-12-07 if test meets SLOs.

Dependencies & responsibilities (MAP draft):
- Helix: supply helix-traffic-profile.csv and test tenant by 2026-11-24 (Milestone: traffic handoff).
- Redwood (Product Ops): provision dedicated pool (estimate 4xA100 equivalent), upload sizing workbook to shared Drive by 2026-11-26.
- Redwood (SRE): run the stress run and produce latency/cost delta report within 24h of test.

Attachments: stress-test-runbook-v1.pdf (runbook), sample sizing workbook.

If either window works, I will book and circulate a short run checklist and primary contacts. Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Regards,
Priyom
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Gonzalez <alex.gonzalez@helixhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Banerjee <p.banerjee@helixhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-23T09:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: scheduling peak QPS stress test & MAP milestone

Thanks, Priyom — good summary. Quick clarifications from our side: 
- We can provide the traffic profile with 1-min granularity; attaching the first-pass file (helix-traffic-profile.csv). The peak is mostly API traffic — ~18k QPS sustained for 10 mins with background 6k QPS. Mobile sessions spike independently (approx +3k QPS).
- Preferred window is option (1) on 2026-11-29 02:00–04:00 UTC. That aligns with our infra team's low-traffic maintenance slot.
- We will need Redwood to confirm whether the dedicated pool needs GPUs with >80GB aggregate memory for KV caches; please include the sizing worksheet result.
- Please confirm whether an on-call Redwood engineer will be present during the run and a Slack channel for live troubleshooting.

Attaching: helix-traffic-profile.csv

Alex
Director, Platform Engineering
Helix Health

Looping you in after Alex's confirmation and the attached traffic profile. Action items for Redwood ops ahead of the agreed window (2026-11-29 02:00–04:00 UTC):

1) Tessa: please provision a dedicated pool sized for the attached profile. Alex flagged ~18k QPS sustained; my initial sizing worksheet suggests 4xA100 equiv but confirm memory for KV caching (>80GB aggregate). Need provisioning done and confirmed by EOD 2026-11-26.
2) Karthik: draft the run-day on-call rota and Slack channel; designate primary SRE and backup. Please include rollback and fallback model variants in the runbook.
3) Marissa: prepare a one-page executive summary of expected cost delta vs. hosted baseline for the deal addendum. We aim to have the sizing + cost signed by 2026-12-07 if test passes.

I've attached the traffic CSV Alex sent. Tessa/Karthik — let me know if you need any more details from Helix before provisioning.

Thanks,
Priyom

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-11-29T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Post-demo: scheduling peak QPS stress test & MAP milestone — window confirmed

Alex / Priya — final confirmation: 2026-11-29 02:00–04:00 UTC is locked. Summary of final run plan and responsibilities: 

- Run window: 2026-11-29 02:00–04:00 UTC (60m sustain + 5-min spike sequences baked into the script).
- Helix responsibilities: provide test tenant credentials in a secure vault by 2026-11-27 18:00 UTC; run traffic generator from your side to avoid third-party traffic shaping.
- Redwood responsibilities: provision dedicated pool (4xA100 equivalent, 96GB total aggregate KV cache) by 2026-11-26 17:00 UTC; Redwood SRE (Karthik primary) will be on-call and available in #redwood-helix-run Slack channel.
- Acceptance criteria: 95th percentile p99 latency below 450ms for API traffic and error rate <0.5%.
- Post-run deliverables: detailed latency and cost delta report within 24h; final sizing workbook (redwood-dedicated-sizing.xlsx) and one-pager for purchase addendum.

Links & attachments:
- Runbook: https://drive.redwood.company/s/helix/stress-runbook
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HLX-2026-0921
- DocuSign addendum (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/HLX-ADDENDUM-0921

Please reply with any last-minute blockers. Alex — we will have a Redwood engineer in the Slack channel during the entire window and will share a live metrics dashboard link 10 minutes before start.

Thanks — see you on Monday (run day).

Priyom
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: stress-test-runbook-v1.pdf, redwood-dedicated-sizing.xlsx
